title: Metro Recharge

examples.explanation: Days 1 to 3 cost 40 + 0 + 25 = 65. Days 2 to 5 cost 0 + 25 + 60 + 15 = 100. Day 4 alone cost 60.

hints: Answering each query with a loop is O(n) per query, up to 2.5 · 10⁹ steps in total. What could you compute once, before reading the queries?
Let P[i] be the total of the first i days, with P[0] = 0. How do you get the total of days l..r from two values of P?
Totals reach 10⁵ · 10⁹ = 10¹⁴. Use 64-bit integers for P.
